find_stations_in_area.description: Find the sensor stations inside a rectangle on the map, most recently reporting first, each with its newest readings.
find_stations_in_area.display_str_template: Find openSenseMap stations in an area.
find_stations_in_area.name: find_stations_in_area

parameters.description: The longitude of the area's west edge, in decimal degrees, for example 7.55 for Münster. Keep each side under 5 degrees.
parameters.name: west

parameters.description: The latitude of the area's south edge, in decimal degrees, for example 51.9 for Münster. Keep each side under 5 degrees.
parameters.name: south

parameters.description: The longitude of the area's east edge, in decimal degrees, for example 7.7 for Münster. Keep each side under 5 degrees.
parameters.name: east

parameters.description: The latitude of the area's north edge, in decimal degrees, for example 52.0 for Münster. Keep each side under 5 degrees.
parameters.name: north

parameters.description: Only stations placed like this. Choose Outdoors for weather and air quality. Leave empty for every station.
parameters.name: exposures

parameters.description: Only stations with a sensor for this. Leave empty for every station. Stations name their sensors themselves, mostly in German, so each choice shows the name it matches in brackets.
parameters.name: phenomenon

parameters.description: Only stations that sent a reading at or after this moment. Use it to skip stations that have gone quiet. Leave empty for every station.
parameters.name: reported_from

parameters.description: With 'Reported from': the end of that period. Leave empty for up to now.
parameters.name: reported_until

parameters.description: How many stations to return (1-500). The total says how many matched.
parameters.name: limit

has_more.description: Whether more matched than were returned

stations.description: The matching stations, most recently reporting first

created_at.description: When it was registered, as an ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC

exposure.description: Where it is placed: outdoor, indoor, mobile or unknown

group_tags.description: The groups its owner tagged it with

height_m.description: Its height above ground in metres, when the owner gave one

last_reported_at.description: When it last sent a reading, as an ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC; empty if never

sensors.description: What it measures, each with its newest reading

latest_at.description: When that reading was taken, as an ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC

latest_value.description: Its newest reading, or empty if it has never reported

phenomenon.description: What it measures, as the station names it (e.g. Temperatur)

unit.description: The unit its readings are in

get_location_history.description: List where a station has reported from, oldest first. A fixed station has one place; one on a bike or bus has many.

description: Read live and past readings from openSenseMap's community sensor stations: find stations near a place, in an area or a group, read a station's latest temperature, humidity, fine dust and other values, pull a sensor's history and summarise readings across an area. No account or API key is needed.
